entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""My brother always told me never to..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Grand Duchy's royal residence w..."
entries.dialogueText: The Grand Duchy's royal residence was built on the foundations of an ancient paleacco, one of the stone fortifications that gave Pales its name.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After his coronation, Duke Axel Rei..."
entries.dialogueText: After his coronation, Duke Axel Reinhart had hired an up-and-coming local architect to expand the old building into a swooping, bulging wood and glass structure that seemed almost alive.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The reception room had been moved t..."
entries.dialogueText: The reception room had been moved to the top floor, and boasted enormous curved windows with a view of the Pales skyline. Its soaring, angular skyscrapers were unlike anything built in Rizia.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""So this is the 'Pearl of the Antac..."
entries.dialogueText: "So this is the 'Pearl of the Antacean.'"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You sound unimpressed, Captain.""
entries.dialogueText: "You sound unimpressed, Captain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Amazing what Lespian money can buy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Amazing what Lespian money can buy, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hard to believe all of this sprung..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hard to believe all of this sprung up in the last few decades alone."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm a simple man, sir. Give me the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm a simple man, sir. Give me the classicism of Palas Rezna over... whatever this is."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Truly a feat, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Truly a feat, sir."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""'Amazing' is one word for it, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "'Amazing' is one word for it, sir."

entries.dialogueText: "By the way, Your Majesty, the men your cousin turned over have been extradited to Wehlen. There's still no word on what will happen to them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Still in the works, sir. It's too sensitive to assign to anyone else, so I'll have to pick it back up once we have significant time in the capital."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where are you from, Titus?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where are you from, Titus?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Born and raised in Porte Drazon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Born and raised in Porte Drazon."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My father was killed during the op..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father was killed during the operation to take back Pales. I took up championship boxing to support my family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He gave his life for a good cause.""
entries.dialogueText: "He gave his life for a good cause."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So much senseless bloodshed. May i..."
entries.dialogueText: "So much senseless bloodshed. May it never happen again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I bet you were good at it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I bet you were good at it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Good enough to get noticed by mili..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good enough to get noticed by military recruiters. I do miss those days in the ring sometimes."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""For what it's worth, sir, he belie..."
entries.dialogueText: "For what it's worth, sir, he believed in the cause. He never turned against King Valero."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""He believed in it with all his hea..."
entries.dialogueText: "He believed in it with all his heart. He never turned against King Valero."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you've never been to Pales befo..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you've never been to Pales before?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""No, sir. My father fought in the o..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, sir. My father fought in the operation to take it back. Actually, he was killed here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry if this visit is bringing up..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry if this visit is bringing up bad memories."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Not a problem, sir. He died fighti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not a problem, sir. He died fighting for what he believed in."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A panel in the wall slid open, and..."
entries.dialogueText: A panel in the wall slid open, and a secretary clad in a pastel minidress emerged. She motioned for me to enter.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Into the breach.""
entries.dialogueText: "Into the breach."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sit tight. This ought to be quick.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sit tight. This ought to be quick."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Make yourself comfortable. This mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Make yourself comfortable. This might be a while."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Will do, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Will do, sir."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Good luck, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The secretary announced my entrance..."
entries.dialogueText: The secretary announced my entrance. I stepped into the room and was greeted by Duke Reinhart.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Your Majesty. A pleasure to finall..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. A pleasure to finally meet you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: The Palesian ruler was tall and square-jawed, with looks out of an adventure serial. I recalled that the tabloids had nicknamed him "Duke Dashing".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was tall, square-jawed, with loo..."
entries.dialogueText: He was tall, square-jawed, with looks out of an adventure serial. I recalled that the tabloids had nicknamed him "Duke Dashing".

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Likewise. You have a beautiful cas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Likewise. You have a beautiful castle."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I returned Duke Reinhart's bow. He..."
entries.dialogueText: I returned Duke Reinhart's bow. He spread his arms out wide.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Really? You think it's beautiful?""
entries.dialogueText: "Really? You think it's beautiful?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""As do I.""
entries.dialogueText: "As do I."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No ministers? No aides?""
entries.dialogueText: "No ministers? No aides?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I thought it best to try and settl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought it best to try and settle this business between ourselves. Like in the old days."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""How do you like my castle?""
entries.dialogueText: "How do you like my castle?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's very... modern.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's very... modern."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's breathtaking.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's breathtaking."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have to be diplomatic, don't I?""
entries.dialogueText: "I have to be diplomatic, don't I?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A corner of his mouth turned up."
entries.dialogueText: A corner of his mouth turned up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: He raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I wasn't sure about it myself. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wasn't sure about it myself. But when you're the leader of such an advanced economy, there's always pressure to keep up with the times. You know how it is."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The secretary left, closing the doo..."
entries.dialogueText: The secretary left, closing the door behind her. The Duke and I took seats on opposite sides of a wooden conference table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His posture was casual, even as he..."
entries.dialogueText: His posture was casual, even as he regarded me with intensity.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.dialogueText: "Tell me, Your Majesty. What is the meaning of this?"

entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""And how can I trust you?""
entries.dialogueText: "And how can I trust you?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""By claiming the Aureus field, we a..."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Your Majesty, you must understand..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, you must understand that Pales doesn't owe Rizia anything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They supported your independence....."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your family must have realized the..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should never have been put in..."

entries.dialogueText: "That's brave talk, Your Majesty."

entries.menuText: "I see no other choice but arbitration. The Alliance of Nations will decide ownership." [Arbitration]

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I offered you a chance for peace t..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you're admitting it. You're a p..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you're admitting it. You're a puppet of Lespia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My own experts would say that you'..."
entries.dialogueText: "My own experts would say that you've acted in clear violation of the Alliance of Nations Directive on Offshore Resources."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Duke Reinhart bristled at that rema..."
entries.dialogueText: Duke Reinhart bristled at that remark.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Your Majesty, the Reinhart family..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, the Reinhart family has ruled over the Palesian peninsula for just as long as the Torases have ruled over Rizia."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""If you are going to question our l..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you are going to question our legitimacy, you may as well question your own."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's precisely why I will not le..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's precisely why I will not let this go. Western superpowers have no place meddling in South Merkopan affairs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I too have the backing of powerful..."
entries.dialogueText: "I too have the backing of powerful interests. You do not want to incur the wrath of Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""You are ignoring ANDOR's nuances...."
entries.dialogueText: "You are ignoring ANDOR's nuances. It leaves much more room for ambiguity than other laws of its kind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You ruled on behalf of the Valgos..."
entries.dialogueText: "You ruled on behalf of the Valgos Empire, who stole Pales from Rizia. I would hardly call that 'legitimate'."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I respect the length of your famil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect the length of your family's rule. However, Pales has only been a sovereign nation for a fraction of that time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are correct. Both of our famil..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are correct. Both of our families have clung to power for too long."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our island counts just as much as..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our island counts just as much as your barely legitimate country."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't make the rules. Our claim..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't make the rules. Our claim is clearly valid according to the Alliance of Nations Directive on Offshore Resources."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Caleqabiz may be small, but it is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Caleqabiz may be small, but it is still a part of the great nation of Rizia."

entries.dialogueText: "You chose a convenient time to get patriotic about an island full of exiles."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We've established that we have dif..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was under pressure from him then..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was under pressure from him then. Now that I am king, I am no longer beholden to his wishes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did not and still do not want to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not and still do not want to cooperate with Pales after the violence of the 1920s. That doesn't mean I want a repeat of that conflict."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do still have doubts about Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do still have doubts about Pales' legitimacy. But this resource dispute overrides them."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""But until and unless Rizia respect..."
entries.dialogueText: "But until and unless Rizia respects Palesian sovereignty, we will be forced to assert ourselves."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His expression turned more serious."
entries.dialogueText: His expression turned more serious.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Duke Reinhart drew himself upright."
entries.dialogueText: Duke Reinhart drew himself upright.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Yes, Pales was part of the Valgos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Pales was part of the Valgos Empire. But we developed our own laws and customs. Even our own language."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""When the Empire fell apart, what w..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the Empire fell apart, what were we supposed to do? Simply give up everything we had built?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your family only came to power bec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your family only came to power because the Valgos Empire put you there. And now the Empire is gone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your 'sovereignty' only exists bec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your 'sovereignty' only exists because of Lespian support. Without it, Pales would crumble."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""And what of Rizia and Rumburg? Wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what of Rizia and Rumburg? What of the deal your father made with Wehlen to keep House Toras in power?"

entries.dialogueText: "And what of Rizia? Trudging forward with the legacy of the mighty Rezenids, long after their empire should have turned to dust."

entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Yes, Pales was part of the Valgos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Pales was part of the Valgos Empire. But we developed our own laws and customs. Even our own language."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""When the Empire fell apart, what w..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the Empire fell apart, what were we supposed to do? Simply give up everything we had built?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales could have kept its cultural..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales could have kept its cultural identity intact if it had rejoined Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Regimes end. It was your time.""
entries.dialogueText: "Regimes end. It was your time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. No, I suppose not.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. No, I suppose not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would have done that before turn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would have done that before turning to Lespia."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.dialogueText: "So they accepted help from Lespia. The only country willing to support our independence."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I heard what it was like back then..."
entries.dialogueText: "I heard what it was like back then. Rizia and Morella picking at us like vultures. Goddamn Valgsland trying to provoke a revolution from the sidelines."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Lespia was the only nation willing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia was the only nation willing to support our independence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They supported your independence....."
entries.dialogueText: "They supported your independence... by making you dependent on them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your family must have realized the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your family must have realized their motives for doing so were less than pure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should never have been put in..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should never have been put in that position, Your Grace. My country should have left Pales alone."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Thank you for acknowledging that...."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for acknowledging that. But it doesn't change anything."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Of course. But thanks to Rizia's a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. But thanks to Rizia's aggression, they had no choice."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""By making us wealthy. By giving us..."
entries.dialogueText: "By making us wealthy. By giving us the capacity to defend ourselves against aggressors like you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now that Lespia is an ATO member,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that Lespia is an ATO member, they won't want to be connected to a monarchy for long. They'll have you overthrown the first chance they get."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand why Pales accepted Le..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand why Pales accepted Lespia's aid. But now that Morella is in league with Valgsland, you could get caught between superpowers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough with the history lesson. Wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough with the history lesson. What do you plan to do *now*?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you met their new prime minis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you met their new prime minister? Do you trust him?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His gaze hardened as he looked at m..."
entries.dialogueText: His gaze hardened as he looked at me.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""No, they won't. Not while they nee..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, they won't. Not while they need our gas."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""So you see, Your Majesty, we can't..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you see, Your Majesty, we can't let Rizia take it from us. Not without a fight."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His gaze hardened as he looked at m..."
entries.dialogueText: His gaze hardened as he looked at me.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Not as long as we have a bargainin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not as long as we have a bargaining chip. And we do, right at the bottom of the Antacean."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His gaze hardened as he looked at m..."
entries.dialogueText: His gaze hardened as he looked at me.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I am bringing this up so you under..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am bringing this up so you understand the stakes."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""We have an obligation to Lespia. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have an obligation to Lespia. When they ask us for natural gas, we can hardly refuse."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Calm down, Your Grace. We have no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Calm down, Your Grace. We have no intention of starting a fight."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Then prove it. Send your ships bac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then prove it. Send your ships back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If it's a fight you want, it's a f..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it's a fight you want, it's a fight you'll get."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are not the only country with..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are not the only country with obligations. And the gas field is large enough to be split."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His gaze hardened as he looked at m..."
entries.dialogueText: His gaze hardened as he looked at me.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I trust Patricio Alvarez more than..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust Patricio Alvarez more than I trust you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A compelling argument. But we won'..."
entries.dialogueText: "A compelling argument. But we won't cede the field to you for nothing."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Are you sure, Your Majesty? You re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure, Your Majesty? You remember what happened in the 1920s."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Sharing a gas field requires close..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sharing a gas field requires close collaboration. You'll excuse me if I don't feel like collaborating with Rizia right now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will when you send *your* ship b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will when you send *your* ship back."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Why not? It would avoid us both a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why not? It would avoid us both a lot of headache."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am considering it. But we have t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am considering it. But we have to come to an agreement regarding the gas field first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How do I know you won't just resum..."
entries.dialogueText: "How do I know you won't just resume drilling if I call for a retreat?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. We had you beat until you wen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. We had you beat until you went crying to Lespia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. We lost a lot of good men fig..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. We lost a lot of good men fighting Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I remember better than you. You we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I remember better than you. You weren't even born."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I admit I acted harshly. If I agre..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admit I acted harshly. If I agree to call back our ships, can we have a reasonable talk?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't have to collaborate. Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't have to collaborate. Just stay on our respective sides."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you don't choose to collaborate..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you don't choose to collaborate, we will force you to do so."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""No, I will not withdraw Pales' pre..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I will not withdraw Pales' presence from the field as long as the Rizian navy is there."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Excuse me, Your Majesty, but I'm f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse me, Your Majesty, but I'm feeling less than agreeable with your ships' guns pointed at mine."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""If I do that, you can call your sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I do that, you can call your ships right back in."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Lespia only offered us minor assis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia only offered us minor assistance with weapons and equipment. Your own internal strife harmed you more than Lespia did."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Invading Pales, you mean.""
entries.dialogueText: "Invading Pales, you mean."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Then you know how unwise it is to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you know how unwise it is to provoke my Grand Duchy."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""At last, something resembling sani..."
entries.dialogueText: "At last, something resembling sanity from the King of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I am asking you politely. Withdraw..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am asking you politely. Withdraw your navy, and we will talk."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I will give you one chance. Withdr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will give you one chance. Withdraw your navy, and we will have a reasonable discussion about the gas field."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""There's too much potential for dis..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's too much potential for disagreement. Which Rizia has already proved itself incapable of handling."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Please, Your Majesty. Neither of u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. Neither of us want escalation."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Before we continue this conversati..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we continue this conversation, I must insist that you withdraw your navy."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Yes. Withdraw your navy, and we wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Withdraw your navy, and we will continue this conversation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Giving in to Pales, and therefore..."
entries.dialogueText: "Giving in to Pales, and therefore Lespia, would make us look weak internationally. We can't afford that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia needs the gas in that field,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia needs the gas in that field, Your Grace. Do not test us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's the principle of the thing. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the principle of the thing. I truly believe the field's proximity to Caleqabiz gives us a right to it."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""And I believe it doesn't. So where..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I believe it doesn't. So where does that get us?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Just because you need it doesn't m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just because you need it doesn't make you entitled to it."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Have you thought about how it woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you thought about how it would make us look to cave in to Rizia?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Please, Your Majesty. We can discu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. We can discuss this. But I want you to withdraw your navy first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Absolutely not. My ships are stayi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely not. My ships are staying right where they are."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If it means we can move forward, t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it means we can move forward, then fine. I'll call off my ships effective immediately."
entries.menuText: "If it means we can move forward, then fine. I'll call off my ships effective immediately." [Recall Fleet]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Duke Reinhart breathed a shaky sigh..."
entries.dialogueText: Duke Reinhart breathed a shaky sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Duke Reinhart paled. He swallowed b..."
entries.dialogueText: Duke Reinhart paled. He swallowed before speaking.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""That's it, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's it, then."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I see no choice but to call in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see no choice but to call in the AN for arbitration."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Great. They'll easily rule that Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. They'll easily rule that Pales acted in direct violation of the AN Directive on Offshore Resources."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""And even if it applies, ANDOR is n..."
entries.dialogueText: "And even if it applies, ANDOR is not black and white. It's very nuanced."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita. If it is said, so it is,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita. If it is said, so it is, so it will be."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's only nuanced compared to its..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's only nuanced compared to its predecessors. It doesn't stand alone as a brilliant piece of legislation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have the support of the interna..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have the support of the international community. Pales doesn't."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I never cared for those old Wruhec..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never cared for those old Wruhecist saws."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The rules over our maritime border..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rules over our maritime borders seem clear to me. And to my councilors as well."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""A directive we never ratified.""
entries.dialogueText: "A directive we never ratified."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're disrespecting our religion..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're disrespecting our religion now?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come on. What happened to solving..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on. What happened to solving disputes man to man?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I won't risk it. The potential for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't risk it. The potential for inciting an armed conflict is too high."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not a saw, it's a promise. Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not a saw, it's a promise. Your words shall translate into actions."
